table() renders a full-featured interactive table with live search, column sorting, pagination, numeric thresholds, row links, and slide-over detail drawers. { "type": "table", "headers": ["Agent", "Model", "Runs (24h)", "Status"], "rows": [ ["Researcher", "gpt-4o", 412, "Online"], ["Code Reviewer", "claude-3.7-sonnet", 198, "Online"], ["Docs Assistant", "gpt-4o-mini", 845, "Online"], ["Triage Bot", "gemini-2.5-flash", 63, "Idle"] ], "searchable": true, "sortable": true, "page_size": 10 }

Pass a pandas or Polars DataFrame (duck-typed with zero extra imports), or a list of dicts, straight to aiui.table(df) — works both on @aiui.page and inline in chat via await aiui.send_block(aiui.table(df)):

Parameter Type Description data DataFrame / list[dict] Optional positional pandas/Polars DataFrame or list of dict rows (infers headers automatically). headers, rows list Column headers and row values (arrays or dicts when columns is supplied). columns list[dict] Typed column specs (key, label, type: badge, number, date, sparkline, thresholds). searchable, sortable, page_size bool / int Client-side search box, header sorting, and page size. row_detail, actions dict / list Row detail drawer template and per-row action buttons.
